Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.coverage

Class CreateCoverageRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.coverage.CreateCoverageRequest
public class CreateCoverageRequest extends Object
Request DTO for creating a coverage.

Builds the request body for POST /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages.

Two modes:

  • isNew mode (recommended): specify only the name; GeoServer reads metadata automatically from the raster reader. Use CreateCoverageRequest.isNew("mycov").
  • Partial-definition mode: specify name plus additional fields explicitly. Use CreateCoverageRequest.of("mycov").srs("EPSG:4326").enabled(true).

 // isNew mode — GeoServer reads metadata automatically from the store reader
 CreateCoverageRequest.isNew("mycov")

 // Partial-definition mode — explicit field values
 CreateCoverageRequest.of("mycov")
     .title("My Coverage")
     .description("Raster layer from GeoTIFF")
     .srs("EPSG:4326")
     .projectionPolicy("REPROJECT_TO_DECLARED")
     .enabled(true)

      public static CreateCoverageRequest isNew(String name)
      isNew mode: only the name is required. GeoServer reads all metadata from the store reader automatically. Use this when the store was uploaded with configure=none.
      Parameters:
      name - the coverage name (must not be null or empty)
      Returns:
      a new request in isNew mode
